issues.description: The collection GET endpoint for persons uses different path names across artifacts: the problem statement (and tests) refer to endpoints under "/persons" (e.g., PUT /persons/{personId}/parents), the template PersonResource defines the GET mapping at "persons", but the solution PersonResource uses "people" for the getAllPersons endpoint. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual API (the collection of Person resources) can confuse students when mapping requirements and tests to the implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single, consistent endpoint path for the persons collection across all artifacts. Change the solution's @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons") so it matches the problem statement, template, and tests (or update all references to use "people" consistently).
